suggestions.label: Increase our RCF
suggestions.sends: I've just signed a new contract with a major automotive manufacturer and need a £300,000 increase to my credit facility to fund it

events.speaker: agent
events.text: Right, I can help with that. I can see Thornfield already has a £200,000 revolving credit facility. The file will test your requested £300,000 increase against policy, serviceability and the signed contract, then propose a £500,000 limit if it holds.

data.plain_summary: Increase existing £200,000 RCF to £500,000 for automotive working capital

events.speaker: agent
events.text: Okay, the 2024 management accounts are validated. Revenue is up 10% year on year, EBITDA is £620,000, DSCR is 2.1x, leverage is 34%, and current ratio is 1.6x.

events.speaker: agent
events.text: Now, the signed contract is validated. I found one variance: the management accounts reference a £780,000 pipeline value, while the signed contract value is £760,000. The requested £300,000 headroom is about 39% of the signed contract value and still passes the serviceability checks, so I'll flag the variance for Sarah Chen and send the case for credit review.

issues.message: Management accounts cite £780,000; signed contract shows £760,000.

events.speaker: agent
events.text: Done. Your RCF increase case is now with Sarah Chen for credit officer review today. The prepared memo shows the amount bridge clearly: £200,000 existing limit plus your requested £300,000 increase equals a proposed £500,000 limit at SONIA + 2.8%, with the risk grade unchanged at Medium.

next_steps: Sarah Chen reviews the prepared credit memo

steps.label: Under review
steps.detail: Sarah Chen reviewing the credit memo

loan_options.name: RCF amendment + FX hedge
loan_options.repayment_note: Revolving line with interest on drawn balance; annual review
loan_options.fee: No establishment fee; FX quote priced separately
loan_options.best_for: Strong fit when Thornfield wants flexible drawdown against the new contract and import-cost certainty through a linked hedge.
loan_options.fit: Flexible headroom for inventory and receivables while keeping the existing facility structure.
loan_options.consider: SONIA-linked pricing moves with market rates; hedge only covers agreed import exposures.
loan_options.comparison: Choose this if flexibility matters more than a fixed repayment schedule.

loan_options.name: Working capital term loan
loan_options.repayment_note: Monthly principal and interest matched to the production ramp
loan_options.best_for: Strong fit when Thornfield wants a ring-fenced contract funding line with a fixed repayment profile.
loan_options.fit: Clear repayment schedule for the contract build without increasing the revolving facility limit.
loan_options.consider: Less flexible if drawings fluctuate; full amount is funded up front.
loan_options.comparison: Choose this if repayment certainty matters more than revolving headroom.
